## Wave-2 exclusion results for `symmetric-sextic-residual` (#117): rigorous `deg D ≥ 7`, no semi-invariant denominator of degree 7 or 8, and a sector correction (referee-checked)

Prepared for `kejace` with Claude (Anthropic) assistance; no human review yet; nothing Lean-verified; no certificate claimed. No claim of nonexistence of a certificate is made: the statements below exclude explicit families only.

**Setup.** $F = p_6(X)+p_6(Y)+\tfrac{5}{7}\,e_2(X)e_2(Y)\,(e_2(X)+2e_2(Y))$, $A = e_3(X)e_3(Y)$, $q=1$. Symmetry $S_3\times S_3\times\langle\tau\rangle$ ($\tau\colon Y\mapsto -Y$); the residue of $A\,\Omega/F^2$ transforms by $\mathrm{sgn}\otimes\mathrm{sgn}$ with $\tau$-character $+1$. Certificate identity as in `formal/README.md`: $A D^2 - D\sum N_i\partial_iF + F(D\,\mathrm{div}N - N\cdot\nabla D) = F^2Q$, $\deg N_i = d+1$, $\deg Q = 2d-6$ for $d=\deg D$.

**Sector correction.** The residue sector of $[A]$ is the polynomially $S_3\times S_3$-invariant, $Y$-odd part of the Jacobian ring, with Hodge numbers $(h^{3,1},h^{2,2},h^{1,3}) = (17,52,17)$; our earlier local notes had $(1,10,1)$, which is the residue-*trivial* sector (polynomial character $\mathrm{sgn}\otimes\mathrm{sgn}$), spanned at $(3,1)$ by $\Delta_X\Delta_Y$ — exactly the class the symmetric Fano quotient of `why.md` serves. Recounted independently by a Molien–Koszul formula and by Burnside counting in the Fermat monomial model (exact for every smooth invariant $F$ by the equivariant Koszul resolution). So $[A]$ is one of seventeen $(3,1)$-classes of its character, not a unique one.

**Proven (characteristic 0).**

1. **Every legal denominator has degree $\ge 7$**, for any $Y$-parity and including Jacobian-ideal elements. (i) E1: $\{D : AD\in J(F)\}_d = J(F)_d$ for $d\le 6$ (Jacobian ranks at their complete-intersection values at four primes: $2^{31}-1$, $2147483629$, $10^9+7$, $10^9+9$). (ii) *Hessian relaxation* (a necessary condition): if $(D,N,Q)$ is a certificate and $N^0$ is any polynomial vector with $\sum N^0_iF_i = AD$, then $R^0(D) := D\,\mathrm{div}N^0 - N^0\cdot\nabla D \in J(F)_{2d}$ (reduce the identity mod $F$, use Euler and the Koszul syzygies of $\nabla F$; the $F$-multiple freedom of $D$ only moves $R^0$ inside $J$). For $d=5$ ($D = c\cdot\nabla F$) this reads $A\,(c^{T}H_Fc)\in J_{10}$; multiplication by $[A]$ is injective on $R_4$, so $c^{T}H_Fc = 0$ as a polynomial, which by Euler makes $c$ a singular point of $X$. For $d = 6$ ($D = w\cdot\nabla F$, $w$ linear, 35 parameters modulo the Euler direction) the resulting quadric system is $\mathfrak m$-primary: msolve's reduced grevlex leading ideal contains a pure power of every variable. Three independent implementations agree (primes $2^{31}-1$, $10^9+7$, $10^9+9$).
2. **No $S_3\times S_3\times\langle\tau\rangle$-semi-invariant denominator of degree 7 or 8** (all eight character/parity sectors; the $\mathrm{sgn}\otimes\mathrm{sgn}$ sectors contain no E1-admissible element at all). Every Gröbner basis was replayed by the referee; Singular confirms dimension 0 (`vdim` 11, 112, 7 on three of them). At degree 9 only the two $\mathrm{sgn}\otimes\mathrm{sgn}$ sectors are closed so far.
3. **Exact dual (Farkas) certificates**: no certificate exists with fixed denominator $D_7 = \Delta_X\,e_2(X_0^2,X_1^2,X_2^2)$, its mirror $D_7^Y$, $E_X(F)=\sum X_i\partial_{X_i}F$, $E_Y(F)$, $E_X(F)-E_Y(F)$, or $\Delta_X\Delta_Y$ (integer left-kernel vectors of the full fixed-$D$ linear system with $y\cdot b\ne 0$; all six replayed in exact arithmetic).

*Transfer conditions for the modular Gröbner steps* (checked in degrees 12–14 at $2^{31}-1$ and 11–14 at $10^9+9$): $\operatorname{rank}_p J_{d+6}$ and $\operatorname{rank}_p J_{2d}$ equal their rational values, and the Koszul complex of $\bar F$ is exact in degree $d+6$ ($H_1 = 0$), so the computed lift $N^0$ may be replaced by any other and a complex certificate reduces to a nonzero, non-radial solution of the mod-$p$ system.

**Conditional reduction** (depends on the book's prescribed-support theorem and sum principle; the group-theoretic step is checked): for $\chi = \mathrm{sgn}\otimes\mathrm{sgn}$ and any transposition $s$, the $\chi$-isotypic projection of $H^4(X)^{s}$ vanishes, so $[A]\in\mathrm{served}(\Delta_X^a\Delta_Y^b S) \iff [A]\in\mathrm{served}(S)$ for $G$-semi-invariant $S$: sign-character denominators reduce to invariant ones of degree $d-3a-3b$ (consistent with item 3: $D_7$ already fails through the degree-4 E1 failure of $e_2(X^2)$).

**Screened only (mod $p$ or numerical; not proofs).** All 12 non-Jacobian E1-kernel basis elements of degree 8 are inconsistent as single denominators ($p = 10^9+7$). Joint variable-projection search over the *complete* E1-admissible families (invariant sector $d\le 10$, unrestricted Jacobian family $d\le 6$, sign sectors $d=7$, vertex-cone families $d\le 9$): only stable nonzero minima (best relative residual $2\cdot10^{-6}$ at $d=10$, unchanged by Gauss–Newton polishing); 358 kernel classes and 90 random combinations inconsistent mod $p$.

**Not established.** The full degree-7 relaxation (61 unknowns per parity; both Gröbner runs timed out or were killed; mixed parity never run) and anything about non-semi-invariant denominators of degree $\ge 8$. The remaining degree-9 sectors were still running at hand-off.

**Open items.** Finish degree 7 (full) and degree 9 (sectors); exact characteristic-0 Gröbner versions of the sector closures; the affine cosets $D_{\mathrm{sporadic}} + J_8$; the conditional reduction as a theorem with its citations; any construction mechanism for the 17-dimensional sector.

**Reproduction** (links are to commit `3461b4aa2974` of the research branch of `kejace`'s fork; packet inputs, msolve/Singular files, JSON receipts, Farkas pickles and `verify_farkas.py`): [wave2-excl packet](https://github.com/kejace/sextics/tree/3461b4aa29742db3766caf548bcab82ff6e35cb5/research/results/symmetric-sextic-residual/wave2-excl) · [referee README with the verdict table and replays](https://github.com/kejace/sextics/blob/3461b4aa29742db3766caf548bcab82ff6e35cb5/research/results/symmetric-sextic-residual/wave2-excl/README-referee.md) · [exclusion report](https://github.com/kejace/sextics/blob/3461b4aa29742db3766caf548bcab82ff6e35cb5/research/notes/wave2-symmetric-sextic-residual-excl.md) · [search report](https://github.com/kejace/sextics/blob/3461b4aa29742db3766caf548bcab82ff6e35cb5/research/notes/wave2-symmetric-sextic-residual-search.md). Tools: msolve, Singular, python-flint.

**Credits.** Framing from `why.md` and Chapter 3 §§3.3–3.4 (hodge-computer); the related accepted quotient constructions by `fqlx` (reflection-coupled-fano, PR #150) and `benediamond` (cyclic-triple-fano, PR #153) were studied as mechanisms; this thread had no prior comments. All computations by `kejace`'s agent sessions (exclusion, search, verification, aggregation, referee).
